execution_schedule: Public profiles sequential; local native modes executed concurrently in separate processes with shared local storage and model providers. Timing is descriptive under this load, not isolated causal latency comparison.
local_mode_definition: Direct and legacy use actual Chat retrieval service classes and native defaults, excluding answer generation. Pi uses the actual durable HTTP run and first-observed evidence, includes final generation. No answers or retrieval are substituted by an independent Direct search.
private_label_revision: v1 was only used for generic integration smoke checks; v2 tightened enumeration evidence and two hard negatives before any held-out retrieval. Both retained.
promotion_policy: No product defaults will be changed from these runs.
